title: Doublade Paradox Rift Reverse Holo 132/182 Scarlet & Violet Pokémon TCG Common
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Doublade Paradox Rift Reverse Holo card is a must-have for any Pokémon TCG collector! With a stunning design by Bun Toujo, this card features the Metal attribute and a Standard card size. It is from the Scarlet & Violet set and has a card number of 132/182. The card is a Stage 1 Pokémon type with a rarity of Common and a finish of Reverse Holo. 

The card is made of high-quality card stock material and was manufactured by Nintendo in the United States. The card features the character Doublade with an HP of 90 and is suitable for ages 6+. This card is perfect for any fan of the Pokémon TCG game and collectors alike.
